methods.empirical: Canonicalize the two observed odor vectors lexicographically. Decide the side from the sign of the cumulative canonical taste evidence and use the shared motor uniform for ties. Update the corresponding odor pair with actual taste times action and orientation. Recent3 uses the last three observations of that pair. Both rules carry memory across phases and receive no cue IDs, noise flags, or clean answers.
methods.short_native: Replay each frozen graph on the disjoint 8-contact validation split with the native gate and receipt path. Both branches use the same worlds and uniforms. Disabled blocks actual writes and still delivers its native receipt.
methods.statistics: All means weight births equally. Intervals are paired, pointwise 95% hierarchical bootstraps over births and worlds. Accuracy labels are clean-side correctness.
